resource: Placement depth below a corpse ItemInstance
allocation_impact: Only direct entries of the corpse item itself are admitted destinations; the composite foreign key (parent_item_instance_id, world_id) -> game_item_instances plus the parent-live-CORPSE_MATERIALIZATION-receipt check make a deeper placement (a bag inside a corpse) unrepresentable in this slice.
boundary_tests: max=1: a loot entry whose parent is the death's own corpse ItemInstance is accepted
max+1=2: a loot entry whose parent is itself a corpse container entry is rejected by the database
notes: D131; decision §4.2 mirrors GAMEITEM01-PLACEMENT-DEPTH; nested bags inside corpses are a later decision. Registered by OTV2-20260929-d3-1-corpse-migration.
